description: Draw a page's anatomy as an Excalidraw diagram: its regions, the ranked ways to get its data, proof rows, the best route and what the page is made of. Returns a download link for the .excalidraw file (give it to the user; it opens at excalidraw.com or in Obsidian) and a file_name. With include_scene, also the scene itself (a few hundred KB).

include_scene.description: also return the full Excalidraw scene JSON (large). Default false: just the download link

name: xray_diagram
